results.name: heldout-unanswerable-what-risk-score-did-the-underwriter-assign-to-th-16f03e
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 5 rows in 7 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT
    ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS risk_score
FROM acme_insurance.main.underwriting_assessment AS ua
JOIN acme_insurance.main.assessment_result AS ar
    ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.agreement_assessment AS aa
    ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy AS pol
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pol.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.insurable_object AS io
    ON pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.geographic_location AS gl
    ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.location_address AS la
    ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(la.Line_1_Address) LIKE '%5315 martin ave%'
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  SUM(case when policy_amounts.Policy_Amount_Identifier in (from "main"."premium") then policy_amounts.Policy_Amount end) AS written_premium
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS policy_amounts
LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" AS insurance_policies ON policy_amounts.Policy_Identifier = insurance_policies.Policy_Identifier
WHERE insurance_policies.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  AND policy_amounts.Effective_Date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND policy_amounts.Effective_Date < '2020-01-01'

results.name: heldout-unanswerable-how-did-the-loss-reserve-for-claim-12312702-chan-ea10b3
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 84 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ca.Event_Date::DATE) AS month,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_reserve
FROM acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE c.Company_Claim_Number = 12312702
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ca.Event_Date::DATE)
ORDER BY
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ca.Event_Date::DATE)
LIMIT 500
